problem.title: Two Sum
problem.statement: Given an array of numbers and a target, find two numbers that add up to the target and return their positions. Each problem has exactly one answer.
problem.hint: If the current number is x, then its partner must be target - x. The question is: has that partner appeared before?
problem.walkthrough:
Example array [3, 8, 11, 2, 7] and target = 9.

See 3: partner = 9 - 3 = 6. Never appeared. Save 3 in notebook.
See 8: partner = 9 - 8 = 1. Not there. Save 8.
See 11: partner = 9 - 11 = -2. Not there. Save 11.
See 2: partner = 9 - 2 = 7. Not there. Save 2.
See 7: partner = 9 - 7 = 2. There! 2 is in the notebook. Answer: positions 3 and 4.

Key insight: use a hash map (notebook) so you can check if the partner exists in constant time. Just one pass.
